title: Northgate Gift Cards and Merchandise Return Cards Terms: Expiry, Dormancy Fees and Cash Payout
content:
Under the Northgate Gift Cards and Merchandise Return Cards terms, only promotional value may expire: the Northgate Promotional Gift Card is the one type whose unused value expires, and it can be used through 45 calendar days after issue. No card type is charged a monthly fee for being unused. A balance is paid out in cash only where state law requires it, except that a Northgate Promotional Gift Card balance is never paid out in cash.

## Terms by card type

| Card type | Unused value expires | Calendar days after issue through which the card can be used | Monthly fee charged on an unused card (USD) | Whether a balance can be paid out in cash |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Northgate Gift Card | no | not applicable, value never expires | 0.00 | only where state law requires |
| Northgate eGift Card | no | not applicable, value never expires | 0.00 | only where state law requires |
| Northgate Merchandise Return Card | no | not applicable, value never expires | 0.00 | only where state law requires |
| Northgate Promotional Gift Card | yes | 45 | 0.00 | never |
| Northgate Business Bulk Gift Card | no | not applicable, value never expires | 0.00 | only where state law requires |
| Northgate Reloadable Gift Card | no | not applicable, value never expires | 0.00 | only where state law requires |

The monthly fee on an unused card is shown for every type at 0.00 because Northgate charges none.

## The same terms, stated per card

1. A Northgate Gift Card, Northgate eGift Card, Northgate Merchandise Return Card, Northgate Business Bulk Gift Card or Northgate Reloadable Gift Card keeps its value without expiry, with no fee for being unused, and its balance is paid out in cash only where state law requires it.
2. A Northgate Promotional Gift Card can be used through 45 calendar days after issue, carries no fee for being unused, and its balance is never paid out in cash.

## Questions on these terms

**Does an unused Northgate Gift Card lose value over a year?** No. It does not expire and no monthly fee is charged on an unused card.

**Can the balance of a Northgate Promotional Gift Card be paid out in cash where state law requires cash payouts for other cards?** No; its cash payout term is never.
